minutes.headline: Superintendent presented a five-year staffing plan and FY21 budget timeline; committee accepted PTO and other donations.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the superintendent's presentation on identified needs for the coming fiscal year, a five-year staffing plan, and the budget timeline, including a proposal to move the March budget hearing back a week. It also read finance policies, approved committee goals, and accepted several donations including a large PTO gift. Negotiating representatives for custodial and paraprofessional bargaining were discussed.

what_happened.line: The superintendent presented identified needs for the coming fiscal year, a five-year staffing plan and the budget timeline; the committee voted to accept the presentation.
The superintendent recommended moving the March 4 budget hearing to March 11 to wait for health insurance costs; members discussed it without settling.
The committee accepted all of the donations, including a large PTO gift split between principal gift accounts and a request-for-funds program for staff.
The committee waived reading of several finance policies and later waived second reading of other policies.
The superintendent and another administrator will start groundwork for custodial and paraprofessional negotiations and report back to the committee.

why_it_matters: The staffing plan and the timing of health insurance costs shape the school budget that later goes to residents as a tax and Town Meeting question.
A hearing date that depends on insurance figures means the public may have less time, or later notice, to weigh in on the school budget.
watch_next: Whether the March budget hearing is moved from March 4 to March 11 once health insurance costs are known.
